source_definition: The starting point is 3-SAT: given a Boolean formula with at most three literals per clause, decide whether a satisfying assignment exists.
target_definition: The target instance consists of an m × n nonnegative rational matrix X and a nonnegative rational threshold τ, both encoded in binary. It asks whether nonnegative real matrices W of size m × 2 and H of size 2 × n satisfy the error bound below. The factors may be asymmetric and need not have rational entries.
required_result: The goal is a deterministic polynomial-time map from a 3-SAT formula to a target instance, such that the formula is satisfiable if and only if the target error bound is attainable. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
equation: <math display="block" aria-label="Squared Frobenius norm of X minus W H is at most tau"><msubsup><mrow><mo>‖</mo><mi>X</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>W</mi><mi>H</mi><mo>‖</mo></mrow><mi>F</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>≤</mo><mi>τ</mi></math>
